race.comment: Tough race. SHOW 'EM HOWL (5) slashing run in town last start when he came from back in the field for a close-up sixth over over 1300m at Randwick Kensington in BM72 grade. Ready for this trip and looks set to peak third-up. SAVVYROCKER (9) capable on her day and strips fitter for this on the backup. Dropped in trip with a handy sixth over 1200m at Coffs Harbour. Placed at this track and trip and has genuine top-three claims. A POUND OF SALT (4) was a month between runs when he savaged the line to finish third over 1280m at Muswellbrook. Nicely placed over the extra distance and look for him late. BOLD HOI HO (8) sat on the strong tempo and faded quickly in the straight with a poor eleventh over 1600m in the Coffs Harbour Cup last week. This is more to his liking and stays in the calculations.
